metadata.description: Real ferry-route geometry snapshots derived from OpenStreetMap ferry routes for build-time route lines. Route relations first; standalone `route=ferry` ways only where no relation covers the crossing.

sources.note: Generated there from OpenStreetMap ferry relations via Overpass and vendored here as a build-time snapshot.
Relation member way geometry, unmodified. Covers the BC Ferries, Black Ball, Western Pacific Marine and county-run routes the Seattle-only snapshot above does not reach.

Ferry routes OSM maps as a bare way with no parent relation, so the relation queries above cannot see them. The query returns 66 such ways; vendored here are only the four that carry a route leg no relation reaches — the two Kitsap Transit fast ferries, the Gambier–Keats crossing, and Seattle–West Seattle. The other 62 either duplicate relation coverage or are berth approaches, freight barges and water taxis this dataset does not model beyond Seattle–West Seattle. Way geometry, unmodified.
